mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two kinds of proteins was worthwhile because it connected the different RNA instructions to different cell jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second pathway felt somewhat repetitive because it followed the same messenger-then-building-block pattern as the first, although the comparison helped.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cells with the same DNA could use different instructions and make proteins for such different purposes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, though they did not explain exactly how the messengers activate genes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how these different cells become larger tissues sounds interesting, especially after the hint about a later muscle chapter.
